svg.text: 2026-11-15 · STAGE 493 · TOPIC 133 · SVG 137 · 135TH FAQ 🎉 · 496 DIMS · 🎉 HISTORIC 60TH ROUND, P980, 135TH FAQ & 935-TEST MILESTONE (P979–P980 🎉)
SIP RFC 6794 / RFC 7090 Service URN Subservice Parent-Fallback & LoST (RFC 5222) Cache Guard
P979 Hierarchical urn:service:sos.* / counseling.* Parent Fallback & [1, 4] Depth · P980 🎉 <=500ms LoST Timeout & [60, 3600]s Cache
❌ Unprotected RFC 6794 / RFC 7090 Service URN Risks
1. Unrecognized Subservice URN Rejected with SIP 404/416
• Caller dials urn:service:sos.poison or counseling.suicide
• Exact-match SBC table returns 404 Not Found instead of parent
• Crisis or life-safety call dropped on subservice mismatch!
2. Synchronous LoST (RFC 5222) Lookup Hang (>5000ms)
• ESRP queries external LoST XML server for PSAP URI
• Network timeout blocks INVITE for 10s with no cached fallback
• Emergency caller hears dead air and hangs up in panic!
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P979–P980)
• Specialized sos.*/counseling.* subservices fail closed with 404
• External LoST outages paralyze regional emergency routing
Verdict: BLOCK (Subservice URN 404 / LoST Lookup Stall)
✅ Deterministic RFC 6794 / RFC 7090 / RFC 5222 Guards (P979–P980 🎉)
P979: Rightmost-Label Parent-URN Fallback & [1, 4] Depth Gate
• Iteratively strip unknown subservice labels → parent URN
• Mute commercial AI scripts on urn:service:sos*/counseling*
• Clamp URN subservice dot-label depth in [1, 4] levels
• unhandledSubserviceUrn404OrCommercialOverrideDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc6794Rfc7090ServiceUrnSubservice...()
P980 🎉 (60th Round / 135th FAQ / 935 Tests): LoST Cache Fallback
• Enforce <=500ms LoST findService timeout with Stale-While-Revalidate
• Clamp cached PSAP/Crisis URI mapping TTL in [60, 3600]s
• Route immediately to default regional PSAP on LoST timeout
• lostLookupTimeoutOrExpiredCacheCallDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc5222LostFindServiceTimeoutLocalCache...()
Verdict: PASS (0 Subservice 404s · [60, 3600]s LoST TTL · 935 Tests 🎉)

Standards: IETF RFC 5031 (Service URN), RFC 6794 (Emergency Subservices), RFC 7090 (Healthcare/Counseling URNs), RFC 5222 (LoST).
